breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between the fully-specified Dirichlet boundary conditions and the additional request for periodic boundaries. It resolved this by explicitly stating to use the Dirichlet conditions and ignore the periodic one, which aligns with the ground truth prompt that omits the contradictory periodic condition.
